description: Whether a domain name can be registered at Ex2 right now (live WHOIS, results kept 5 minutes), with the one-year register, transfer and renewal prices of its extension and the link to order it (or to transfer it, when taken). One name per call; limited to 120 checks per 10 minutes.

currency.description: Currency of the prices: EUR for France and Europe, CAD for Canada, USD elsewhere.

domain.description: The domain name to check, e.g. "mybakery.ca" (a URL or www. prefix is fine).

lang.description: Language of names, features, specifications and links: fr for French speakers.

name: check_domain
title: Check an Ex2 domain name
